rationale: A bounded guidance correction can eliminate repeated waits without a scheduler or daemon.

body: Reconcile Lux instructions/checkpoints with P112/P117: routine isolated low-resolution functional checks may run concurrently subject to observed resource limits. Reserve uncontended runs for performance measurements or demonstrated conflicts. For necessary shared-resource handoffs, retain the holder until explicit cleanup/release and use unique grants so delayed messages cannot authorize overlap. Keep general handoff guidance in canonical Conductor skills through normal install; Lux GPU specifics stay local. Validate fresh-agent scenarios for routine concurrency, measured contention, and delayed grants. No scheduler, daemon, or blanket lock. Evidence: LUX-P112/P117/P122.
title: Remove stale GPU locks and clarify exceptional handoffs
observation: P112/P117 explicitly reject blanket GPU serialization. Current orchestration text still says one native GPU test; P122 records crossed grant/revocation messages during recent enforcement.
inferred_cause: Stale project instructions and ambiguous asynchronous handoffs reintroduced unnecessary exclusivity.
